**Released as v0.51.3** (2026-08-31T21:19:08Z, tag on `1b3b34d`; CI green on all four workflows, Release workflow success).

First criterion met. The second — the `TypeError` count stopping — is now purely a deployment wait: `~/.claude/plugins/cache/cc-notes/cc-notes/` still tops out at 0.51.2 on this workstation, and Claude Code refreshes the plugin cache at session start rather than on release. Nothing to force by hand.

**To confirm once the cache rolls over**, on each host:

    ls ~/.claude/plugins/cache/cc-notes/cc-notes/ | tail -2        # expect 0.51.3
    grep -hc "TypeError: expected string or bytes-like object" ~/.cache/captain-hook/logs/*.log

The count was 13 here and 2 on forge-studio at the time of the fix; it should stop growing rather than reset, since the existing log files keep their history.
